method.identity: All old rows versus all current routes. Route IDs/numbers are not used to score or force a one-to-one correspondence. Old 9 is compared too.
method.semantics: Reviewed aliases from compare-historical-routes; additionally 中图=中心图书馆, and compound components 中心图书馆地科院→中心图书馆 / 8教李园→李园. Neither makes a compound an identical stop.
method.dice: Current labels are projected onto the union of historical landmark keys. Each current key takes its strongest match: confirmed=1, compound/area=alpha. Dice=2*sum(current weights for old keys)/(old unique key count + sum(all current pooled weights)). Extra comparable corridors are penalized. Unrecognized fine current labels are disclosed but unassessed.
method.order: Weighted LCS of first-occurrence unique old keys against all actual geometry-visit labels, divided by ALL unique old keys. Each current position can be consumed once. No cyclic rotation, inferred closing edge, or source-array substitution.
method.endpoints: Mean match weight for first/last RAW old labels versus first/last geometry-reference labels. Repeated old endpoints remain repeated; these are not proven operating terminals.
method.score: 0–100 heuristic: 60% landmark Dice + 30% order coverage + 10% reference endpoint agreement. Compute both complete orientations and choose their maximum; order and endpoints must use the same orientation. Not an accuracy percentage or probability.
method.uncertainty: Default alpha=.5, repeat with 0 and 1. Report every scenario winner and default runner-up when the margin is under 2 points; this is a declared sensitivity rule, not a confidence interval.
method.limitations: Coarse old landmarks cannot measure every detour or physical overlap. Similarity does not establish a rename, replacement, closure, stop coordinate identity, or current operating direction. No routing data is changed.
